session.description: Polar LEO shell with the Walker-star seam. Six counter-rotating pairs between plane 5 and plane 0 come and go by range twice per orbit, beside thirty co-rotating pairs that stay within their terminal limits. A range-transition experiment; tracking never binds here.
session.name: earth-leo-polar-seam
